title: Preserve v3 artifacts
decision: All corrections are written under Resultados/v3_1; v3 remains immutable.

title: Do not select using test
decision: Any additional test calculation is descriptive and cannot alter the frozen model.

title: Keep guardrails
decision: Stability 80%, release-risk upper bound 5%, and superiority interval excluding zero remain fixed.

title: Audit calibration before reporting
decision: Compare identical raw scores, cross-fit calibration by Build_Id, and report ties explicitly.

title: Audit ResponseTime direction
decision: Concurrency and Iterations increase with load; lower ResponseTime milliseconds are stricter.

title: Economics is conditional
decision: Break-even and evidence-anchored scenarios precede any conditioned Monte Carlo result.

title: Negative results remain valid
decision: No result is removed or guardrail changed to obtain a positive conclusion.
